rows.en: Ai: "Huh? Where's Ymir?"
Touya: "O-Oh... Resting in her room now, I guess."
Ai: "Hmm... Then Ymir's all right."
Yamato: "Huh? Why do you think so?"
Ai: "Because Touya wouldn't leave someone who's feeling down
all alone, would he?"
Yamato: "I see."
Clovis: "...So, what did you do?"
Touya: "What's with those expectant eyes?!"
Arthur: "I'd very much like to hear about it too."
Fain: "D-Don't tell me..."
Touya: "You guys..."
Kasumi: "Oh... Ymir..."
Ymir: "Everyone..."
Clovis: "Perfect timing. If Touya won't answer,
we'll just ask her."
Touya: "Hey, I said..."
Clovis: "...Well? How was it?"
Ymir: "How was what...?"
Clovis: "Touya.
He went to cheer you up, didn't he?"
Ymir: "..."
Clovis: "Ohhh. I see, I see..."
Touya: "No, that's not what happened..."
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "Urk..."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "No, I said..."
Aurelie: "..."
Ai: "Oh, do excuse me!"
Arthur: "It's hard being popular.
But it's proof of how much they care about you.
Make sure you settle things properly in the end..."
Ai: "Oh, Touya. I saw Ymir earlier.
She seems all right now."
Yamato: "Maybe that's proof Ymir's grown stronger herself."
Ai: "Hmm... So, what did you do, Touya?"
Touya: "Huh? What did I...? Nothing..."
Ai: "That doesn't seem like you."
Yamato: "Huh? Why not?"
Ai: "Because Touya wouldn't just leave someone
feeling down, would he?"
Yamato: "I see."
Kasumi: "Oh... Ymir..."
Ymir: "Everyone..."
Celica: "Are you all right?"
Ymir: "Y-Yes. Now isn't the time to be lost in grief.
Stopping Dr. Debish's project
comes first..."
Touya: "You don't have to push yourself."
Ymir: "...Yes, I'm all right. Thank you."
Ai: "...Well, Ymir seems to be feeling better anyway.
There's only one thing left to do..."
Yamato: "Face Dr. Debish."
Touya: "Yeah. We didn't settle it last time,
but this time, we'll finish it properly."
Ymir: "...Captain, I'm sorry for the trouble I've caused."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Ymir: "N-No. Thank you."
Celica: "About what we do next...
Why don't we return to the Holy Land for a bit?"
Touya: "Is something wrong?"
Celica: "We're running short on supplies,
and we're missing some parts for Rayblade too."
Ymir: "Captain, may we?"
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Ymir: "Yes. Then let's return to the Holy Land."
Ivel: "...Welcome home, Ymir."
Ymir: "Y-Yes... I'm back."
Ivel: "It seems I've caused you a painful experience.
I'm sorry."
Ymir: "So you knew after all..."
Ivel: "Yes. Though I didn't know that Lyle Enroad
was your father."
Ymir: "Huh?"
Ivel: "I met her after she jumped into this era 29 years ago.
Wenimas told me part of the truth.
Then, after giving birth to you, Wenimas
left this place."
Ymir: "Why... Didn't you tell me...
the truth?"
Ivel: "Because it was Wenimas's last wish...
Not as the daughter of a ≪Ze=Ode≫ researcher,
but as an ordinary girl. That's how she wanted you to live."
Ymir: "..."
Ivel: "Ymir. You may be confused now,
but whoever your parents were, that doesn't deny your own
existence. Ymir is Ymir.
Nothing more, nothing less."
Ymir: "Yes. I understand..."
Celica: "Then you knew about Rayblade too?"
Ivel: "...Rayblade and ≪Ze=Ode≫
do indeed come from the same lineage.
But the issue isn't Rayblade itself.
It's the will of the person controlling it.
Power can be good or evil, depending on who uses it."
Ymir: "...Why did you keep it secret?"
Ivel: "To avoid unnecessary confusion.
But whatever the reason, I apologize for keeping it from you.
I'm sorry."
Touya: "How many people know about this?"
Ivel: "No one, apart from everyone here.
Until Rayblade was entrusted to me 29 years ago,
I didn't know myself."
Arthur: "I see. Like Dr. Lenis, she jumped to a time
earlier than the others..."
Ivel: "Yes. At first, she wouldn't tell me anything.
But one day, about half a year later, she suggested the other ≪Ze=Ode≫
researchers might have jumped into the future.
She told me where Rayblade was hidden, then
disappeared."
Celica: "That's new to me. Then sheltering Dr. Wenimas
was something you didn't report
to anyone?"
Ivel: "Yes. Though she fought to stop the project,
that was only one of the theories about her.
The view that she was still one of the ≪Ze=Ode≫ researchers
remained strong.
That hasn't changed much even now, and I wanted to avoid
her presence becoming known."
Touya: "Huh? Wenimas and Lenis weren't seen
in a good light?"
Ai: "Don't ask me."
Ivel: "The public sees them as much the same as the other researchers.
After all, that explosion did happen.
But when I looked into her eyes, I knew she truly
wanted peace for this world.
That's why I told no one."
Ymir: "But she didn't tell you the details?"
Ivel: "No. She intended to resolve it alone.
...Touya. Queen Alforina entrusted the
Resonance Crystal to you, and Rayblade chose you too.
I believe this is what Wenimas spoke of when she left,
the 'time that will one day come.'
I'm certain everything began on that day 29 years ago,
and is now approaching its end.
...The same goes for the rest of you.
Perhaps everyone gathering in this place, at this time,
is the work of heaven's guidance.
Please, save this world.
I ask this of you..."
Clovis: "W-Well, I don't know how much we can do,
but we'll give it everything we've got."
Arthur: "If our strength can help this world,
gladly. That was our intention all along... Right, Touya?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah...
But no more secrets from now on."
Ivel: "...I'm sorry."
Ai: "Anyway, even if Rayblade is part of ≪Ze=Ode≫,
that doesn't make everything we've done a lie.
Nothing changes, does it?"
Touya: "Well, yeah. I guess what matters is how we think about it."
Ai: "Then we just keep doing what we've been doing."
Ivel: "...Thank you."
Ai: "Oh, right.
Has there been any movement from Zigrim?"
Touya: "Why ask that out of nowhere?"
Ai: "Why not? I just remembered."
Ivel: "Rest assured. The Kingdom of Agarthia and
the Zigrim Republic will formally sign a peace treaty
here in the Holy Land. That has been decided."
Ai: "That old man actually kept his promise..."
Ymir: "...I hope this puts an end
to the war..."
Celica: "I doubt we can create a world without war.
But we can work to prevent wars from starting.
Maybe now is exactly the time for that."
Arthur: "As long as we cling to the boundaries between nations,
humanity will never be free of conflict."
Clovis: "In the end, we could only choose to settle things
through fighting too. But knowing that's wrong
is what lets us take the next step."
Aurelie: "That sounds like self-justification."
Clovis: "If you don't justify yourself somehow, you can't keep fighting.
Besides, when you've gained 'power' like this,
you have to struggle with 'arrogance' and 'self-control' too.
That isn't easy."
Aurelie: "Oh? And have you won that struggle?"
Clovis: "The only thing that could defeat me
is a beautiful woman's tears."
Aurelie: "Yes, yes. Say whatever you like.
...Anyway, whatever reasons we give,
there's no such thing as a righteous battle.
We can leave someone else to judge us.
We just do what we can."
Ai: "Exactly! No point getting tangled up in difficult thoughts.
Let's go in and get it done!"
Ivel: "When you say it, I almost feel you really could.
But don't let your guard down.
Your opponent is Dr. Debish, after all..."
Ai: "Yes, ma'am."
Fain: "U-Um... I don't see her anywhere..."
Ai: "Now that you mention it... Normally she'd have already..."
Emy: "Big Sisteeer!"
Fain: "Oof!"
Ymir: "E-Emy..."
Emy: "Big Sister, you're safe...
I'm so happy!"
Ymir: "Th-Thank you..."
Fain: "You! This time, I'll finish you!"
Emy: "Hmph. As if someone like you could cut me down!
I won't let you."
Fain: "What?! Don't get cocky, you Second!"
Fain: "...W-Well? Come at me!"
Emy: "...There we go."
Emy: "...I-I'll let you off just this once.
You did keep your promise, after all."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Emy: "...W-Well, you were rather impressive, for you...
...A-Anyway... Um... Thank you..."
Fain: "H-Hmph!"
Ivel: "...My, my. I thought Emy had eyes only for you,
but it seems a rival has appeared, Ymir?"
Ymir: "Oh, please don't tease me."
Ivel: "Hohohohoho!"
Doris: "...Oh."
Sharl: "Hello."
Doris: "H-Hello..."
Sharl: "No need to be so wary.
Outside our machines, you're stronger than I am.
So, what did you just hide?"
Doris: "...This."
Sharl: "A scarf?"
Doris: "Yes. I'm embroidering it a little."
Sharl: "For Father?"
Doris: "His birthday's coming up..."
Sharl: "I see... Though I don't think it would suit Father
very well."
Doris: "...You don't think so?
Anyway, did you need something?"
Sharl: "Must I need something to talk to you?"
Doris: "..."
Sharl: "..."
Doris: "...It's about him, isn't it?"
Sharl: "!!"
Doris: "I thought so... The look on your face when you speak to him...
It's just like mine. But you're father and daughter, aren't you?"
Sharl: "..."
Doris: "It's common enough to admire your father, but...
in your case, it's a little abnormal..."
Doris: "...!"
Sharl: "What... Do you know?"
Doris: "...I love him, and he loves me.
What can you do for him?"
Sharl: "I won't hear that from someone who can only prove she's a woman
by offering her body."
Doris: "You... Don't tell me... You're still..."
Sharl: "Physical contact is primitive
and meaningless."
Doris: "...Poor girl...
You've never truly loved anyone."
Sharl: "...It seems there's no point talking to you.
The doctor is preparing an important ritual.
Don't do anything unnecessary."
Doris: "...'The doctor,' huh..."
Ryord: "L-Lord Render... Are we really taking on
the Liebhofen alone?"
Kinari: "Don't worry. We have Lord Debish
on our side. He'll come help if things get dangerous.
And our machines are new too..."
Goh: "Enough chatter.
Commander... It's almost time."
Render: "Right. Our only target is the Liebhofen.
Sink it, and they'll be like birds with their wings torn off."
Ryord: "Understood. Taking my position."
Kinari: "We'd better do our best so she won't laugh at us.
Well, I'm off."
Goh: "Commander..."
Render: "Sorry. Dragging you into this..."
Goh: "No. I lost someone dear to me that day too.
In that absurd exercise..."
Render: "For the Spirit Mech pilots, eh...
Heh. If it hadn't been for them..."
Goh: "...Let's go."
Ai: "Huh? Another enemy attack?!"
Emy: "Th-That response... It's ≪Ze=Ode≫!"
Xiujian: "Not even time to rest..."
Touya: "Anyway, let's launch! Come on!"
